components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-dark); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { border-color: #6e9098; background: #6e9098; color: #fff; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--accent-dark); font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--active); color: var(--accent-dark); } .ds-btn-outline-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.description: Cancels or backs out of an exceptional action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid #637178; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: #34434a; font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #34434a; background: #edf2f3; color: #1d2a30; } .ds-btn-outline-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Settings Select
components.description: Native select for difficulty or the expansion limit.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-limit">Expansion limit</label><select class="ds-select" id="ds-limit"><option>2,000 expansions</option><option>10,000 expansions</option><option>25,000 expansions</option></select>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 2px 0 6px; color: var(--text); font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 0.375rem 2.25rem 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--control); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background-color: #fff; color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-select { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Board Panel
components.description: Frames one board and its start or target label.
components.css: .ds-board-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--raised); color: var(--text); } .ds-board-panel-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-board-panel-heading h3 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/1.35 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-board-panel-heading span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-board-sample { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; max-width: 306px; margin-inline: auto; } .ds-board-sample span { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--control); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: #fff; color: var(--text); font: 500 24px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; } .ds-board-sample span:last-child { border-color: #86aeb6; background: var(--active); }

components.name: Puzzle Tile Selectors
components.description: A square 3×3 group of native selects for editing board values.
components.css: .ds-puzzle-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; width: min(100%, 306px); margin-inline: auto; } .ds-puzzle-tile { aspect-ratio: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0.25rem 1.15rem 0.25rem 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--control); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background-color: #fff; background-position: right 0.38rem center; background-size: 0.62rem 0.48rem; color: var(--text); font: 500 24px/1 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; text-align-last: center; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-puzzle-tile.is-blank { border-color: #86aeb6; background-color: var(--active); } .ds-puzzle-tile:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-puzzle-tile:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Numbered Route Disclosure
components.description: Reveals the first DFS route as an ordered explanation trail.
components.html:
Show the found route
  1. Initial board
  2. Move blank left
  3. Move blank up
  4. Goal board
components.css: .ds-route-details { margin-top: 16px; } .ds-route-details summary { width: fit-content; color: var(--accent-dark); cursor: pointer; font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-route-details summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-route-list { margin: 12px 0 0; padding-left: 1.75rem; border-left: 2px solid #8ab6bf; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.8; } .ds-route-list li::marker { color: var(--accent-dark); font: 500 12px/1.5 "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; } .ds-route-details[open] .ds-route-list { animation: ds-route-reveal 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-route-reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-route-details[open] .ds-route-list { animation-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.description: Pairs the 3×3 route mark with the student's assignment reference.

components.css: .ds-app-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; width: min(100%, 1440px); min-height: 44px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 32px; background: var(--ground); color: var(--text); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; font: 600 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark { width: 25px; height: 25px; flex: 0 0 auto; fill: #65777d; } .ds-mark-route { fill: var(--accent); } .ds-student { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 16px; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-student-value, .ds-register-number { margin-left: 0.25rem; color: var(--text); font-weight: 500; } .ds-register-number { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-app-bar { min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 16px; } .ds-brand { gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-mark { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-student { align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; text-align: right; } }

components.name: Workbench Sheet
components.description: A white, bordered work surface inside the blue-grey page frame.
components.html:
8-Puzzle DFS Lab

Set initial and goal boards, then run bounded DFS.

Puzzle setup

Each board uses tiles 1–8 and one blank.
components.css: .ds-sheet { width: min(calc(100% - 16px), 1424px); min-height: calc(100vh - 52px); margin: 0 auto 8px; padding: clamp(22px, 3vw, 40px); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); } .ds-sheet h1 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 600 22px/1.2 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/1.3 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-sheet p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-sheet { width: 100%; min-height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 22px 16px 28px; border-inline: 0; border-radius: 0; } }

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: Confirms the expensive exhaustive no-solution demonstration.
components.html:
Confirm exhaustive demonstration

DFS may inspect the full reachable component. This run can take several seconds.
components.css: .ds-confirmation-dialog { width: min(calc(100% - 32px), 34rem); max-width: none; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sheet); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgb(20 48 57 / 20%); } .ds-confirmation-dialog::backdrop { background: rgb(16 30 35 / 52%); } .ds-dialog-body { padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 32px); } .ds-dialog-body h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 600 22px/1.2 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-body p { color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; } .ds-dialog-cancel, .ds-dialog-confirm { min-height: 40px; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font: 500 14px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border-color: #637178; background: transparent; color: #34434a; } .ds-dialog-cancel:hover { border-color: #34434a; background: #edf2f3; color: #1d2a30; } .ds-dialog-confirm { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; } .ds-dialog-confirm:hover { border-color: var(--accent-dark); background: var(--accent-dark); color: #fff; } .ds-dialog-cancel:focus-visible, .ds-dialog-confirm:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The app carries a student's worked-solution folio into a compact builder-like workspace. The pair of boards establishes the puzzle; an ordered DFS route is evidence that belongs below setup. Reading hierarchy stays quiet and ink-first, while the 3×3 tile mark and numbered route supply the visual signature.

Across the surface, a cool blue-grey frame, white working sheet, soft raised panels, and one teal route/selection accent make structure visible without decoration. IBM Plex Sans handles explanation; IBM Plex Mono is reserved for tile values and measured identifiers. The white sheet is this lab's surface treatment, not a universal container for unrelated screens. The build avoids the oversized landing-page headline, generic KPI treatment, paper texture, and decorative grid named in the direction brief.
keyCharacteristics: One teal accent against cool, low-chroma surfaces.
The board pair and ordered route carry the product's visual identity.

rules.name: The Route Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep teal attached to the primary action, route, selection, links, and keyboard focus; let the cool neutrals carry the rest.

rules.name: The Data Face Rule
rules.body: Keep IBM Plex Mono on measured values and board identifiers; all explanatory reading stays in IBM Plex Sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and borders for resting content; reserve elevation for the modal confirmation state.

dos: Do keep teal for primary action, selected-board feedback, keyboard focus, and the numbered route.
Do reserve IBM Plex Mono for tile values, the register number, route indices, and measured search statistics.
Do preserve the visible keyboard-focus outline and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the white sheet and raised board panels as distinct levels of this workbench.
donts: Don't add paper texture or a decorative grid to the current visual world.
Don't turn the puzzle setup into an oversized landing-page hero or a generic KPI dashboard.
Don't replace native selects with non-interactive tile or control lookalikes.
Don't add shadows to resting panels; the dialog is the one elevated surface.
